about.title: About the Labyrinth of Nightmare set
paragraphs: Labyrinth of Nightmare is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG booster set released on 1 March 2003, in the Duel Monsters era. It has 105 cards, and with the 13 other rarities there are 118 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 105 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 118, adding the 13 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
